info.name: Handoff API
info.description: API collection for Handoff – AI-powered website design. Set the `baseUrl` variable to your Vercel deployment (e.g. https://adamcamilleri-github-io.vercel.app).

request.description: Sends a design request to the AI. Returns HTML in the reply field.
Multi-turn conversation with existing page HTML for iterative design.
Edits a single selected element. Requires currentHtml and selectedElementHtml.
Deploys HTML to Vercel. Returns url, projectName, deploymentId. Requires VERCEL_TOKEN.
Creates a Stripe payment link. amount in cents (2000 = $20). Requires STRIPE_SECRET_KEY.
